translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen Maemerhoar
Jesus a teeotae wooan pwoot we nge a sefaaeniti miniwe aepinoamwon iwe eno epeig meoneoiniun we.

Aaemweoi aeremas ra pwigito reen erhai mwaaen e maemerhoar ewon noan epeo giegiy. Igiwe Jesus a weri nepaen aar niugiuniug rhooawe, a aengaeni mwaaen we e maemerhoar pwe, “Aetemaegin naeyi! Monofitimw a mwusunoa.”
Iwe aaemweoi sinsein anniug kkewe ra niuwaennei pwe, “Mwaaen een e aepesa aenneewa Deus!”
Nge Jesus a giuneei niunniuwaen kkewe aar nge a aengaeniir pwe, “Meeta oaw niuwaennei minikkena e aenneew reen?
E mererhaeg pwe sipwe aepesa pwe, ‘Monofitimw a mwusunoa,’ aere sipwe aepesa pwe, ‘Iutae wa faaeraeg noa’?

Iwe, ngaang ipwe pwaeri ngaenigaemi pwe mwaaen we Naiun Aeremas eyor maemaewan wooan soanop pwe epwe oamwusa noa monofit.” Iwe, a aengaeni mwaaen maemerhoar we pwe, “Iutae, pwigi giemw nge wa noa noan imwoamw.”
Iwe mwaaen we a iutae nge a noa noan imwan.
Igiwe aeremas ra weri miniwe, ra mesag tae nge ra aepingepinga Deus reen aan ngaenneer aeremas taeppen mamaaw we.
Jesus a Faingi Matthew
Jesus a siusaengi igiwe nge a weri erhai rhooan iyoiyon tax itan Matthew, emooat noan aan office. Jesus a aengaeni pwe, “Itto tapweaei.” Iwe Matthew a iutae nge a tapweei noa mwirin.
Igiwe Jesus a mwongo noan imwaen Matthew, nge re towunap rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooa monofit ra itto tapweei Jesus me rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun reen table we.
Oatowe aaemweoi Pharisees kkewe ra giuneei miniwe, ra aeiyegiir rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun pwe, “Meeta faan naimi sinsei a mwongo ngaeniir rhooan iyoiyon tax me rhooa monofit kena reen?”
Jesus a rongorong aar kkepas nge a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Rhooakka rese semwaai rese noa reer toagota, pwe rhooakka refaer semwaai.

Oawnoa giutta faaen kkepas een me noan Pwapwior we e Santus: ‘Faayeow minne ngaang i tipaeni, nge saapw maan kkena aar oasoar ngaeniaei.’ Ngaang ise itto pwe ipwe faingiir rhooa mwamwaai, pwe faer rhooa monofit.”
Kkepas Aeiineon Aecchigipin
Iwe rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun John Baptist ra itto reen Jesus nge ra aeiineow pwe, “Meeta faan aemaem me Pharisees aeisooaw aecchigipin, nge rhooan kkayeo kkomwu noawumw rese aecchigipin reen?”

Jesus a paniuwaeniir pwe, “Oaw niuwaennei nge epwe aenneew tipeer rhooakkena re itto reen gupwunon appwiuniupai we igiwe bridegroom we e rhiuwen no reer? Aapw! Nge epwe itto raaenin na repwe pwigi saengiir bridegroom we, nge ina oatona repwene aecchigipin noa.
“Esooar erhai epwe aeyae mengaag ffeo aan epwe pinisa tae wooan erheo mengaag maerhiy, pwe mengaag ffeo we epwe fereei noa mengaag maerhiy we, nge miniwe taeringen epwene faer gin temoag noa.

Esooar erhai epwe aenianong wine ffeo noan nenien wine maerhiy, pwe ina epwe pwoanoa nge wine we e nipiwow nge nenien wine we epwe ffeir noa. Pwe faer wine ffeo epwe itinong noan nenien wine ffeo, pwe ina nge oanongaen repwe gacch.”
Jesus e Aemenewaetae Erhai Aeterhooapwut Nge e Aecchipwatae Erhai Rhooapwut

Igiwe Jesus e aepesa minneen, erhai soamwoonin Jews a itto reen, a foatotiw mmwan nge a aengaeni pwe, “Naeyi aeterhooapwut a maenoa igina, nge wopwe itto rhag iseni tae poawumw wooan, pwe epwe menaw.”
Iwe, Jesus a iutae nge a tapweei noa, nge rhooan kkayeo kkewe naiun ra pwan tapweei.
Eno erhai rhooapwut neeiir eseiug aan peitaeg noa noan seig me ruwowu raeg, a itto me niugiusagiuriun Jesus nge a geotteopa soapwon mengaagiun.
A niuwaennei nong nee tipan, “Aere i geotteopa rhag mengaagiun nge ipwe mamaaw tae.”
Iwe, Jesus a toagun, a weri niewe nge a aengaeni pwe, “Naeyi, wopwe aetemaegin, oamw niugiuniug minne a aecchipwoag tae.” Reen rhag oatowe nge rhooapwut we a mamaaw tae.
Mwirin Jesus a noa noan imwaen soamwoon we. Nge a weriir rhooan arhiuwerhiuw kkewe me pwuwa we ra igin saeng,
a aengaeniir pwe, “Oawtowow oanongaemi! Aeterhooapwut een nge ese mae, pwe aan rhag maiur!” Iwe ra kekkaei aegini.
Nge igiwe aeremas ra toowow niugiun, Jesus a toonong noan sengkin we aaen aeterhooapwut we nge a ammwarhiu tae paiun, iwe a rhimwitae.
Iwe, fioangon miniwe a rheeoi noa wooan oanongaen faniuw we.
Jesus a Aecchipwaar Riiurhai Mwaaen Masparh
Oatowe Jesus a siusaengi pwiuneoi we, riiurhai mwaaen masparh ra pwan tapweei noa mwirin. Ra aepwesaegini pwe, “Naiun David, wopwe faayeogemaem!”
Iwe, igiwe Jesus a toonong noan iimw we, mwaaen masparh kkewe ra itto reen. Jesus a aeiineeor pwe, “Oaw niugiuniug pwe ngaang ipwe mmwenen aeffetanoa mesaemi?” Iir ra paniuwaeni pwe, “Ooa, menap.”
Iwe Jesus a geotteopa meseer nge aepesa pwe, “Meeta oaw niugiuniug ngaeni, epwe pwan wen ngaenigaemi.”
Iwe, a ffatenoa meseer. Nge Jesus a igin ammwir ngaeniir pwe resoapw aengaeni mwo nge erhai miniwe a wen.
Nge iir ra faer noa arheoiuwa noa wunuunun Jesus wooan oanongaen faniuw we.
Jesus a Aecchipwa Erhai Mwaaen Ese Mmwenen Kkepas
Igiwe mwaaen kkewe ra noa, aaemweoi aeremas ra pwigito reen Jesus erhai mwaaen ese mmwenen kkepas pwe ewartae aniu aenneew wooan.

Reen rhag oaton we Jesus a oatowowuw aniu aenneew we saengi mwaaen we, nge a mmwenen kkepas. Oanongeer aeremas kkewe ra mwaar reen nge ra aepesa pwe, “Esaaen yor mwo giuneyarh taeppen minneei me noan Israel.”
Nge Pharisees kkewe ra aepesa pwe, “Soamwoonin aniu aenneew minne efang maemaewan pwe epwe asiiur noa aniu aenneew.”
Jesus e Faayeow Ngaeniir Aeremas

Jesus a faaeraeg fetaen wooan oanongaen aepinoamw me pwugos kkewe. E fenaiuw me noan wutteer Jews, e fenaiuw Kkepas Mwamwaai we reen Mweoiu Naaeng me pwan aecchipwaar aeremas kkewe eweriir mesemesaen semwaai.
Nge igiwe a weriir pwuwaen aeremas kkewe, nge a igin faayeeor, pwe ra no noan affayeo me waeiraes taeppen sheep kkewe esooar no rhooan neginegiir.
Iwe a aengaeniir naiun rhooan kkayeo pwe, “A towunap uwaen menaai, nge re fitiman rhag rhooan gin.
Oaw maeipin ngaeni soamwoonin maat we pwe epwe fangenoa rhooan engaang pwe repwe giniiy oanongaen uwaen maat we aan.”
